81	def flashinfer_autotune(runner: "GPUModelRunner") -> None:
82	    """
83	    Autotune FlashInfer operations.
84	    FlashInfer have many implementations for the same operation,
85	    autotuning runs benchmarks for each implementation and stores
86	    the results. The results are cached transparently and
87	    future calls to FlashInfer will use the best implementation.
88	    Without autotuning, FlashInfer will rely on heuristics, which may
89	    be significantly slower.
90	
91	    Tuning is performed only on rank 0. The resulting cache is broadcast
92	    to every rank so all ranks dispatch the same kernel tactic.
93	    """
94	    import os
95	    import tempfile
96	
97	    import vllm.utils.flashinfer as fi_utils
98	    from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import get_world_group
99	
100	    world = get_world_group()
101	    is_leader = world.rank_in_group == 0
102	
103	    cache_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="vllm_flashinfer_autotune_")
104	    cache_path = os.path.join(cache_dir, "autotune_cache.json")
105	
106	    # We skip EPLB here since we don't want to record dummy metrics.
107	    # When autotuning with number of tokens m, flashinfer will autotune
108	    # operations for all number of tokens up to m, so we only need to
109	    # run with the max number of tokens.
110	    dummy_run_kwargs = dict(
111	        num_tokens=runner.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
112	        skip_eplb=True,
113	        is_profile=True,
114	    )
115	
116	    with torch.inference_mode():
117	        if is_leader:
118	            with fi_utils.autotune(tune_mode=True, cache=cache_path):
119	                runner._dummy_run(**dummy_run_kwargs)
120	        else:
121	            runner._dummy_run(**dummy_run_kwargs)
122	
123	    # Broadcast autotune cache from rank 0 to all other ranks so every
124	    # rank loads the same set of chosen tactics.
125	    tune_results: bytes | None = None
126	    if is_leader and os.path.exists(cache_path):
127	        with open(cache_path, "rb") as f:
128	            tune_results = f.read()
129	
130	    tune_results = world.broadcast_object(tune_results, src=0)
131	
132	    if tune_results is None:
133	        logger.warning(
134	            "No FlashInfer autotune cache entries found."
135	            "Falling back to default tactics."
136	        )

138	        if not is_leader:
139	            with open(cache_path, "wb") as f:

146	            world.rank_in_group,
147	            cache_path,
